Six comments

Charlie Lennon tune

This tune is first in a set called “All About Weaving” on Frankie Gavin’s recording “Frankie Goes to Town”. Charlie Lennon’s original title is “Pedaling Patterns”. The second tune in the set goes by the name “Weaving Dreams”.

↳ Posted by jdicarlo on January 30th, 2005.
